# TMT Fleet Maintenance (Integration Toolkit)

- **Product:** TMT Fleet Maintenance (Integration Toolkit) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic or OAuth 2.0 password grant. Declared security schemes: OAuth2, basic.
- **Access:** Licensed; requires the Integration Toolkit module.
- **To call it you would need:** a TMT tenant host (single-tenant or on-premises) and Integration Toolkit credentials.
- **Documented servers:** `https://example.com` (placeholder in the definition).
- **Definition:** [tmt/v1](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/tmt/openapi/v1.json) (TMT Fleet Maintenance (Integration Toolkit), version integration). Documentation: https://developer.trimble.com/docs/tmt/reference/openapi/v1/.
